title: Every frame of this action movie was made by AI, not animators
title_candidates: Someone is using AI to make a full Bambi action series

caption:
One creator is making a full animated series using AI, and Episode 8 looks like it came from a real studio.

The series reimagines Bambi as an action hero, and each new episode pushes the quality further. What used to need a full animation team and a huge budget is now being done by one person. The reactions online say it all: people genuinely can't tell this wasn't made by professionals.
